note: The frame-time and input-latency gate (scripts/frame-gate.mjs; premium-feel recs R2 and R5). target: the recs' bar (a frame's script time p95 under 16.7 ms on the laptop profile and 33 ms on the phone, no frame over 100 ms, an input answered within 100 ms and 150 ms). fail: the ceiling that blocks a pull request in ci.yml (checks.yml only warns). The ceilings start at twice the target (and 250 ms for the longest frame) because the gate was written without a browser run, so nobody has yet seen what the runners measure; tighten each to the measured number plus a margin once checks.yml has reported, and never loosen one to get a run through. Times in ms.
